description.value: Shark Club is the original flagship location of a Canadian sports bar chain, open since 1993 on West Georgia Street in downtown Vancouver, situated below the Sandman Hotel and fused with pregame energy from both Rogers Arena and BC Place. The two-storey venue is built around towering HD screens and a full menu that goes well beyond sports bar staples—wings and burgers alongside tuna poke, lettuce wraps, and steak frites. It offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery through multiple platforms, making it a practical food stop for cyclists moving through the downtown core.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sharkclub.com/location/vancouver confirms the business is actively open, with the address (180 W Georgia St, Vancouver, BC V6B 4P4) and phone ((604) 687-4275) matching OSM exactly. The website explicitly confirms takeout and delivery are available. No cycling-specific amenities—bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging—are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: The /contact/ subpage lists a different address (310 - 1755 West Broadway, Vancouver, BC V6J 4S5) which appears to be the corporate head office, not the restaurant location — no action needed but worth noting if the directory ever contacts the chain centrally.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible sports bar and grill in downtown Vancouver, confirmed active by the website with matching OSM contact details.
